# Insert and delete: ICH, DCH, IL, DL.

=== ICH opens blank cells at the cursor
source: esctest2 ich.py test_ICH_ExplicitParam
input: abcdef\e[1;2H\e[2@
cursor: 1,2
screen:
|a..bcdef..|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== ICH defaults to one cell
source: esctest2 ich.py test_ICH_DefaultParam
input: abcdef\e[1;2H\e[@
screen:
|a.bcdef...|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== ICH pushes cells off the right edge
source: esctest2 ich.py test_ICH_ScrollOffRightEdge
input: 0123456789\e[1;3H\e[3@
cursor: 1,3
screen:
|01...23456|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== ICH larger than the line clears to the end
source: esctest2 ich.py test_ICH_ScrollEntirelyOffRightEdge
input: 0123456789\e[1;3H\e[99@
screen:
|01........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== ICH inside a wide character blanks both halves
source: xterm ctlseqs ICH; wide-character repair (no half characters)
input: a中b\e[1;3H\e[@
screen:
|a...b.....|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== DCH removes cells and pulls the line left
source: esctest2 dch.py test_DCH_ExplicitParam
input: abcdef\e[1;2H\e[2P
cursor: 1,2
screen:
|adef......|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== DCH defaults to one cell
source: esctest2 dch.py test_DCH_DefaultParam
input: abcdef\e[1;2H\e[P
screen:
|acdef.....|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== DCH larger than the line clears to the end
source: esctest2 dch.py test_DCH_ExplicitParam (count past the line)
input: 0123456789\e[1;3H\e[99P
screen:
|01........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== DCH works outside the top and bottom margins
source: esctest2 dch.py test_DCH_WorksOutsideTopBottomMargin
input: abcdef\e[2;3r\e[1;2H\e[P
screen:
|acdef.....|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== IL inserts blank lines at the cursor row
source: esctest2 il.py test_IL_DefaultParam
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;3H\e[L
cursor: 2,1
screen:
|a.........|
|..........|
|b.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|

=== IL with a count pushes lines off the bottom
source: esctest2 il.py test_IL_ExplicitParam, test_IL_ScrollsOffBottom
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;1H\e[9L
screen:
|a.........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== IL respects the scroll region
source: esctest2 il.py test_IL_RespectsScrollRegion
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;4r\e[3;1H\e[L
cursor: 3,1
screen:
|a.........|
|b.........|
|..........|
|c.........|
|e.........|

=== IL outside the scroll region does nothing
source: esctest2 il.py test_IL_AboveScrollRegion
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;4r\e[1;1H\e[L
cursor: 1,1
screen:
|a.........|
|b.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|e.........|

=== DL removes lines and pulls the screen up
source: esctest2 dl.py test_DL_ExplicitParam
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;3H\e[2M
cursor: 2,1
screen:
|a.........|
|d.........|
|e.........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== DL larger than the screen clears to the bottom
source: esctest2 dl.py test_DL_DeleteMoreThanVisible
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;1H\e[99M
screen:
|a.........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== DL respects the scroll region
source: esctest2 dl.py test_DL_InScrollRegion
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;4r\e[2;1H\e[M
screen:
|a.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|..........|
|e.........|

=== DL outside the scroll region does nothing
source: esctest2 dl.py test_DL_OutsideScrollRegion
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;4r\e[5;1H\e[M
screen:
|a.........|
|b.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|e.........|
